profile.name: David León
profile.role: Computer Systems Engineering Student & Software Development Technician.
profile.bio: I love understanding how things actually work and questioning the "why" behind systems to build clean, efficient, and purposeful solutions. Working autonomously, practically, and adaptably, I always strive to balance functionality, design, and scalability while exploring new ways to build more useful, dynamic, and human-centric software.
